limits: Bounded automatic physical test, not sustained interactive gameplay or independent optical/DAC capture.
Recovery brackets use fresh frame-boundary PCM observation timestamps; no exact load onset timestamp. Reserve minima are sampled.
Reprime is first observation at least 2823 frames after bracket minimum; it does not establish uninterrupted reserve.
CPU comparisons include observers and recorded main/audio/video threads only. Wall wait reduction is not CPU saving.
Failed control tails are censored by the reporter; failed windows never pass.
